method: Local A* route energy plus depth collision cost on clean predictions of a VE diffusion bridge
shared_method: Project executed-prefix endpoint onto valid local A* prior; target 0.25 m farther along it, bounded by prior end; reject cross-track distance over 0.5 m.
Activate goal only when endpoint-to-subgoal correction corridor has footprint-clear observed free space and obstacle margin; never require blind origin-to-final-goal visibility.
Pseudo-Huber goal distance, weight 0.25, combined with collision and proposal regularization costs.
Clean prediction D <- D - scale * sigma^2 * gradient(objective); keep endpoint score, churn and Heun integration intact.
Clip and bound updates; accept only nonincreasing total and collision cost within numerical tolerance.
Optional 16-frame, measured-pose depth memory; occupied evidence wins, unknown is not filled.
local_adaptations: RGB-only Depth Anything V2 metric optical-Z instead of server simulator radial depth; actual level camera height 0.85 m and native intrinsics.

Monocular scale correction uses known camera height divided by fitted horizontal-floor plane height. Require >=55% support in the lower-image ROI, >=35% in each row/column band, <=2.5% relative MAD, and scale in [0.25,2]. No simulator depth, labels or navigation scores. Unsupported observations add no geometry; supported historical evidence can still guide its observed area in static scenes. With no supported observations, fall back to the bridge.
Observed adjacent floor triangles no longer leave projection-sampling holes; all three vertices must be valid and unoccluded, all metric edges <=0.1 m. This interpolates observed surfaces only.
Keep VGCNav 0.045 m action unit, 0.15 m body radius, 0.01 m per-update limit, 32-candidate mean execution, 16 future points executed. Local goal uses decoded index 16 (origin prepended).

Historical depth uses actual RGB frames from executed motion and recovery plus current replanning view. Nearby observations are subsampled at 0.1 m / 0.1 rad before depth inference. Source maps retained, duplicate poses replaced, history reset each episode. No additional simulator motion or privileged views.
Contiguous valid prior prefix required; invalid gaps cannot create goal shortcuts.
variant_identity: Uses server route objective plus its optional map memory; it is not the server route-only ablation. Prefix-risk reweighting and cumulative-budget variant remain disabled.
limits: Predicted depth validity is not depth accuracy. No ground-truth depth or navigation outcomes calibrate or tune the policy.
Scale correction assumes a broadly visible horizontal lower-image plane is the floor. A large horizontal object can be ambiguous; this is not semantic floor recognition or a depth-accuracy guarantee.
Map interpolation and memory cannot invent initial blind-region free space; low evidence can still disable route energy.
Per-update collision-cost decrease is not a guarantee of lower physical collision count or final-path safety.
The existing alpha 0.7 bridge and depth checkpoint remain frozen. New configs are separate from historical V2 evaluation configs.
